DIQQAT: 'Who's got' = 'Who has got' — qisqartma.
Soch haqida 'have got' ishlatiladi: 'She HAS GOT long hair'.

Yuz tuklari 'a' bilan keladi: a moustache (mo'ylov), a beard (soqol).

exercises.explanationUz:
Sifatlarning teskarisi (antonim) — juft holda yodlash eng oson:
  tall ↔ short (bo'y)
  slim ↔ fat (gavda)
  long ↔ short (soch uzunligi)
  straight ↔ curly (soch shakli)
  dark ↔ fair (soch rangi)

  big ↔ small (burun, ko'z)

• FAQAT soch: fair (oq-sariq), red (qizg'ish-sariq)
• FAQAT ko'z: blue (ko'k), green (yashil)
• IKKALASI: brown, black, grey

DIQQAT: soch uchun 'yellow' ISHLATILMAYDI — 'fair' yoki 'blonde' deyiladi.
Ko'z uchun 'black' kamdan-kam — odatda 'dark brown' deyiladi.

exercises.explanationUz:

  'Ann can use the computer very well.' — Ann kompyuterdan yaxshi foydalana oladi.

Ajratish usuli: so'roq bo'lsa va 'please' bo'lsa — iltimos.

sections.title: Grammar: have got ('ve got) / has got ('s got)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the advertisements in Ex. 4 again and complete the sentences using: have, haven't, has or hasn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ex. 4 dagi e'lonlarni qayta o'qing va gaplarni have, haven't, has yoki hasn't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki qadam:
1) EGAGA qarab have yoki has tanlang
   (Mario and Pierre = ular → have; Anna = u → has)
2) E'londagi ma'lumotga qarab tasdiq yoki inkor aniqlang.

tasks.whyUz: Pierre — bitta erkak → Has. E'londa soqol aytilmagan → hasn't.

Anna — bitta ayol → Has. Uning sochi uzun → has.

Mario e'lonida soqol aytilmagan → hasn't.

rule.explanationUz:
'have got' — 'bor' ma'nosini beradi (egalik).
O'zbekchada 'Menda it bor' deymiz — inglizchada 'I have got a dog'.

EGAGA qarab ikki shakl:
• I / you / we / they → HAVE got
• he / she / it → HAS got

Og'zaki nutqda qisqaradi: I've got, he's got.
DIQQAT: he's — bu 'he is' ham, 'he has' ham bo'lishi mumkin.
Farqni 'got' aytib beradi: 'he's got' = he HAS got.
rule.interrogativeNoteUz: Qisqa javobda 'got' TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes, he has.' — 'Yes, he has got' emas.
rule.exampleEn: I've got a dog. My dog has got long ears.
rule.exampleUz: Menda it bor. Itimning quloqlari uzun.
rule.warningUz:
So'roqda 'do/does' ISHLATILMAYDI:
  'Has he got a car?' — TO'G'RI
  'Does he have got a car?' — XATO

Ro'yxatda 11 ta so'z bor, lekin rasmda faqat 8 tasi. Uchtasi YO'Q —

  → I can hear a cat, BUT I can't hear a motorbike.

'but' oldidan VERGUL qo'yiladi.

  very well / very fast   — 95%  (juda yaxshi / juda tez)
  quite well / quite fast — 70%  (ancha yaxshi / ancha tez)

  • fast  — TEZLIK: run fast, walk fast, read fast, swim fast, type fast

rule.explanationUz:
'can' — modal fe'l. Uning ikkita katta afzalligi bor:

1) BARCHA SHAXSLARDA BIR XIL. He/she/it bilan ham -S QO'SHILMAYDI:
     I can · he can · they can   ('he cans' — XATO)

2) O'zidan keyingi fe'l ASOS SHAKLIDA turadi:
     'He can play' — 'to play' ham, 'plays' ham EMAS.

Ikki ma'noda ishlatiladi:
  • QOBILIYAT — Tom can play football. (Tom futbol o'ynay oladi)
  • ILTIMOS  — Can you help me, please? (Menga yordam bera olasizmi?)
rule.negativeNoteUz: To'liq shakl BITTA so'z bo'lib yoziladi: 'cannot' ('can not' emas). Qisqasi — can't.
rule.interrogativeNoteUz:
So'roqda 'do/does' ISHLATILMAYDI: 'Can you swim?' — 'Do you can swim?' XATO.
Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes, I can.' ('Yes, I can swim' emas).
rule.exampleEn: Tom can play football. (ability) / Can you help me, please? (polite request)
rule.exampleUz: Tom futbol o'ynay oladi. (qobiliyat) / Menga yordam bera olasizmi? (iltimos)
rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO: 'can' dan keyin 'to' qo'yish.
  'I can swim'  — TO'G'RI
  'I can to swim' — XATO

W - E - N - D - Y ... C - L - A - R - K - E

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Eshiting va belgilang. Qayta eshitib takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI XIL «I» TOVUSHI — bu o'zbek o'quvchilari uchun eng qiyin farq,
chunki o'zbek tilida bunday ajratish YO'Q.

  /iː/ — UZUN, cho'ziq: read, three, teacher
         Og'iz kengroq yoyiladi, tovush cho'ziladi.

  /ɪ/  — QISQA, tez: six, slim, singer
         Og'iz bo'shashgan, tovush kalta.

NIMA UCHUN MUHIM — ma'no o'zgaradi:
  ship /ɪ/ (kema)  ↔  sheep /iː/ (qo'y)
  sit  /ɪ/ (o'tirmoq) ↔ seat /iː/ (o'rindiq)
  live /ɪ/ (yashamoq) ↔ leave /iː/ (ketmoq)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the advertisements again. Copy the table below and complete it. Then, look at your notes and talk about the people, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: E'lonlarni qayta o'qing. Jadvalni to'ldiring. So'ng yozganlaringizga qarab, namunadagidek odamlar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi 8 qator — 8 ta gapga aylanadi. Namunadagi tartibni saqlang:
1) yosh  2) qayerda yashaydi  3) soch va ko'z  4) bo'y va gavda
5) nimani yoqtiradi  6) nima qila oladi

DIQQAT — uchinchi shaxsda fe'l -S oladi:
• He LIVES in Paris (live emas)
• He LIKES playing (like emas)
Lekin 'can' dan keyin -s YO'Q: 'He can play'.

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures show people from the Wessex area who are missing. Look at their pictures and describe them. Listen and label them with their names from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarda Wessex hududidan bedarak yo'qolgan odamlar. Rasmlarga qarab ularni tasvirlang. So'ng eshitib, ro'yxatdagi ismlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Odamni tasvirlash tartibi (shu ketma-ketlikni saqlang):
  1) YOSH   — young / middle-aged / old
  2) BO'Y-GAVDA — tall, short, slim, well-built
  3) SOCH   — uzunlik + shakl + rang
  4) KO'Z   — rang
  5) BOSHQA — beard, moustache, glasses

Namuna: 'She's young. She's got long straight black hair and green eyes.'
exercises.audioNoteUz: Ismlar audio'dan eshitiladi. Audio bo'lmasa ham mashqning ASOSIY qismi — odamlarni tasvirlash — to'liq bajariladi (quyida har rasm tavsifi berilgan).

tasks.answer: She's young. She's got long straight black hair and green eyes.
He's old. He's got a white beard and a moustache. He wears glasses.
He's young. He's got short fair hair and blue eyes.
She's got long dark curly hair.
He's middle-aged. He's got short grey hair and a moustache.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the speech bubbles with sentences from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Gap pufakchalarini ro'yxatdagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ILTIMOS qolipi: Can you + FE'L + ... , please?

'please' iltimosning muloyimligini oshiradi va odatda OXIRIDA,
vergul bilan ajratilib keladi.

DIQQAT — bu yerda 'can' QOBILIYAT emas:
  'Can you swim?'      → qobiliyat (suza olasizmi?)
  'Can you help me?'   → iltimos (yordam bera olasizmi?)
Farqni VAZIYAT aytib beradi.
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 16-bet — A, B, C, D rasmlar

tasks.answer: Can you give this to Mr Harris, please?
Can you read this for me, please?
Can you help me up, please?
Can you open your books at page 7, please?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words. Then, listen and check. In pairs, act out similar dialogues using your name, address and phone number.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va yetishmayotgan so'zlarni to'ldiring. So'ng eshitib tekshiring. Juftlikda o'z ismingiz, manzilingiz va telefon raqamingiz bilan shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ro'yxatdan o'tish (ro'yxatga yozilish) suhbati. To'rtta ma'lumot so'raladi:
  1) ism    — What's your name?
  2) yosh   — How old are you?
  3) manzil — What's your home address?
  4) telefon — What's your phone number?

RASMIY muloqot belgilari:
  • madam / sir — xonim / janob (mijozga murojaat)
  • Certainly — Albatta (Yes dan muloyimroq)
  • I'd like to ... — ...moqchiman (I want dan muloyimroq)
  • Of course — Albatta

tasks.prompt: A: 4) ___ , Ms Steed. Here's your card. Please, sign it here.
tasks.promptUz: Rahmat, Steed xonim. Mana kartangiz. Iltimos, shu yerga imzo cheking.
tasks.speak: A: 4) ___ , Ms Steed. Here's your card. Please, sign it here.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogues and fill in the missing words. Listen again and repeat. In pairs, act out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni eshiting va yetishmayotgan so'zlarni to'ldiring. Qayta eshitib takrorlang. Juftlikda sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SALOMLASHISH — rasmiylik darajasi bo'yicha uchta qatlam:

  RASMIY:     Good morning. How are you? → Very well, thank you.
  ODATIY:     Hello. How are things?     → Fine, thanks.
  NORASMIY:   Hi! How are you?           → Not bad. / Okay.

Javob berilgach, savolni QAYTARISH odat:
  'And you?' yoki 'How are you?'

Javob variantlari (yaxshidan yomonga):
  Very well → Fine → All right → Okay → Not bad

tasks.prompt: A: Good morning, Paul. 1) ___ are you?
tasks.speak: A: Good morning, Paul. 1) ___ are you?

exercises.instructionEn: Read and fill in the speech bubbles with the sentences below. Now, listen and repeat. Finally, close your books and act out similar dialogues in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: O'qing va gap pufakchalarini quyidagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring. So'ng eshitib takrorlang. Nihoyat, kitobni yopib, juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAYRLASHISH iboralari:

  Goodbye — rasmiy, to'liq shakl
  Bye     — norasmiy, qisqa
  See you (later) — Ko'rishguncha
  Have a nice evening — Kechangiz xayrli o'tsin

JAVOB QOIDASI: kimdir sizga yaxshi tilak bildirsa,
'You too' (Sizga ham) deb javob beriladi.
  'Have a nice evening.' → 'You too.'
Bu juda tez-tez ishlatiladi va yodlab olish kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose one of the people in Ex. 9 and describe him or her to your classmates. The student who guesses correctly chooses another person and the game continues.
exercises.instructionUz: Ex. 9 dagi odamlardan birini tanlab, sinfdoshlaringizga tasvirlang. To'g'ri topgan o'quvchi keyingi odamni tanlaydi va o'yin davom etadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu o'yin tasvirlash so'zlarini mustahkamlaydi. Ilovada siz topuvchi bo'lasiz: tavsif beriladi, siz qaysi odam ekanini aniqlaysiz.

O'yin so'zlari — ularni gapga qo'shib ishlating:
  young / middle-aged → 'He's middle-aged.'
  curly / long / straight → 'She's got long curly hair.'
  slim / well-built → 'He's well-built.'
  beard / moustache / big nose → 'He's got a beard.'

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct answer gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har to'g'ri javob 1 ball. Ko'p ball to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
Butun Unit 2 lug'ati bir joyda. Har so'z uchun mos QOLIPNI tanlang:

• Tashqi ko'rinish sifati → 'He is slim.'
• Soch/yuz qismi → 'She has got full lips.'
• Qobiliyat → 'He can speak Italian.'
• Ravish → 'She can run quite fast.'

DIQQAT — 'with' qolipi: odamni bir gapda tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi:
  'a man WITH a beard' = soqolli erkak
  'a girl WITH long hair' = uzun sochli qiz
Bu 'who has got' ning qisqa varianti.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures from the Photo File section and write descriptions of the people. Write about their age, hair, eyes, height and build.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlardan foydalanib odamlarning tavsifini yozing. Yosh, soch, ko'z, bo'y va gavda haqida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Tavsif qolipi — 5 ta nuqta, shu tartibda:
  1) AGE    — He is twenty years old. / He is young.
  2) HAIR   — He has got short dark hair.
  3) EYES   — He has got brown eyes.
  4) HEIGHT — He is quite tall.
  5) BUILD  — He is slim.

Soch va ko'z uchun HAVE GOT, yosh/bo'y/gavda uchun BE ishlatiladi.
Sochni bir gapda birlashtirsa bo'ladi: 'He has got short dark hair and brown eyes.'

tasks.answer: This is Tom. He is twenty-five years old. He has got short curly brown hair and green eyes. He is tall and well-built.
This is Sally. She is middle-aged. She has got long straight fair hair and blue eyes. She is quite short and slim.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table with information about yourself, then write an Internet advertisement for a pen-friend. Use the texts in Ex. 4 as a model. Start with: Hello!/Hi!... Finish with: Please e-mail me today./Please, be my e-mail pen pal/Hope to hear from you soon.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'zingiz haqingizdagi ma'lumot bilan to'ldiring, so'ng pen-friend uchun internet e'lonini yozing. Ex. 4 dagi matnlarni namuna qiling. Boshlanishi: Hello!/Hi!... Oxiri: Please e-mail me today. / Please, be my e-mail pen pal / Hope to hear from you soon.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 2 ning YAKUNIY ishi — jadvaldagi 9 qator 6 ta gapga aylanadi:

  1) Hi! My name's X and I'm ... years old.   (Name + Age)
  2) I live in SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.              (Live in)
  3) I have got SOCH hair and RANG eyes.      (Hair + Eyes)
  4) I'm BO'Y and GAVDA.                      (Height + Build)
  5) I like/love + FE'L-ing.                  (Like)
  6) I can + FE'L + daraja.                   (Can)
  7) CHAQIRIQ jumlasi.

Har gap Unit 2 da o'rgangan bitta grammatikani ishlatadi.

tasks.answer: Hi! My name's Aziz and I'm fifteen years old. I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. I have got short straight dark hair and brown eyes. I'm quite tall and slim. I like playing football and reading. I can speak Russian quite well. Please e-mail me today!

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkala maqol ham DO'STLIK haqida — Unit 2 nomiga ('A Friend in Need') mos.
Birinchisi kitob unitining nomidan olingan.

tasks.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
tasks.uz: Boshingga ish tushganda yordam bergan — haqiqiy do'st.
tasks.note:
Ma'nosi: haqiqiy do'st sizga QIYIN paytda yordam beradi.
'in need' — muhtoj holatda · 'indeed' — haqiqatan.
DIQQAT: 'need' va 'indeed' qofiyalanadi — shuning uchun esda qoladi.
Unit nomi shu maqoldan olingan.

tasks.en: Lend your money and lose your friend.
tasks.note:
Ma'nosi: do'stga pul qarz berish do'stlikni buzishi mumkin.
'lend' — qarz BERMOQ · 'borrow' — qarz OLMOQ (ikkalasini adashtirmang!)
'lend' va 'lose' bir xil tovush bilan boshlanadi — bu ham esda saqlashga yordam beradi.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikki so'z birikib bitta sifat yasaydi. Chiziqcha SHART.
'like' va 'love' dan keyin fe'l -ing bilan keladi. Bu shakl mashg'ulot nomi ham bo'ladi.
Ba'zi so'zlar -s olmaydi, o'zagi o'zgaradi. Yodlab olish shart.
Tashqi ko'rinish sifatlarini JUFT holda yodlang — ikki barobar tez esda qoladi.

Sifatga -ish qo'shilsa, ma'no YUMSHAYDI: to'liq emas, shunga o'xshash.
Bu juda foydali qo'shimcha — istalgan rangga qo'shsa bo'ladi.

Sifat NARSANI ta'riflaydi, ravish esa HARAKATNI.
Ko'pchilik ravish -ly bilan yasaladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: QOIDASIZ ravishlar — bu betda aynan shular
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikkita eng muhim ravish -ly OLMAYDI. Ular shakli o'zgarmaydi yoki butunlay boshqa so'z bo'ladi.
Familiya oldidan qo'yiladi. NUQTA Britan inglizchasida qo'yilmaydi (Mr Harris).
Harflab aytishda bir xil harf ketma-ket kelsa 'double' deyiladi. Bu tezroq va tabiiyroq.

items.derived: W - I - double L - I - A - M - S
P - H - I - double L - I - P - S

wordFormation.explanationUz: Bir xil ma'no, har xil muloyimlik. Rasmiy vaziyatda o'ngdagisini ishlating.

items.derived: Can you give me this, please?

wordFormation.explanationUz:
Faqat bitta tovush farq qiladi, lekin so'z butunlay boshqa ma'noni beradi.
Bu juftlarni ATAYLAB mashq qilish kerak.
Talaffuz mashqidagi so'zlar shu qoida bilan yasalgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + have/has got + SOCH TA'RIFI + hair
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have got short straight dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening kalta, tekis, qora sochim bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tartib QAT'IY: uzunlik → shakl → rang → hair.
'long straight fair hair' to'g'ri; 'fair long straight hair' XATO.
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → HAS got.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have got brown eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening ko'zim jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'eyes' doim KO'PLIK (ikkita ko'z). 'I have got a brown eye' — noto'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm quite tall and slim. / Mario is tall and well-built.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ancha baland va nozikman. / Mario baland va baquvvat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bo'y va gavda uchun 'be' ishlatiladi, 'have got' emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can play tennis very well. / She can play the piano.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l O'ZGARMAYDI: 'he can play' (plays emas), 'to' ham qo'yilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I love playing computer games. / I like reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'like/love' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi. 'I like read' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've got a dog. / My dog has got long ears.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menda it bor. / Itimning quloqlari uzun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → has got.
O'zbekchadagi 'menda ... bor' shu qolipga to'g'ri keladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Pierre got a beard? — No, he hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pierrening soqoli bormi? — Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l birinchi o'rinda. Qisqa javobda 'got' TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'No, he hasn't' ('hasn't got' emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: TA'RIF (3 gap): EGA + be + bo'y/gavda. EGA + have got + soch/ko'z. EGA + can + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is quite tall and slim. He has got short dark hair and brown eyes. He can play tennis very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ancha baland va nozik. Uning kalta qora sochi va jigarrang ko'zi bor. U tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odamni ta'riflashning to'liq qolipi. Bo'y/gavda uchun BE, soch/ko'z uchun HAVE GOT, qobiliyat uchun CAN.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He lives in Paris. He likes reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Parijda yashaydi. U o'qishni yoqtiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: he/she/it bilan fe'lga -S qo'shiladi. LEKIN 'can' dan keyin qo'shilmaydi: 'He can play' (plays emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: Most people in JOY + are/have got + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Most people in Mediterranean countries are rather short.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'rta yer dengizi mamlakatlarida ko'pchilik ancha past bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Most people' — ko'pchilik. Qat'iy 'all' o'rniga ishlatiladi, chunki hamma bir xil emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have usually got dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning odatda qora sochi bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'usually' HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi: 'have usually got'. Bu tez-tez uchraydigan holatni bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do people from JOY look like?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do people from northern China look like?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shimoliy Xitoy aholisi qanday ko'rinishda?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look like' — tashqi ko'rinishni so'rash. 'How do they look?' ham mumkin, lekin 'What ... look like?' odatiyroq.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'do' ishlatiladi, chunki 'look' oddiy fe'l ('be' emas).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have also got dark brown eyes and full lips.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shuningdek to'q jigarrang ko'zi va to'la labi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'also' — shuningdek. U HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot berishda ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom can play football. / They can swim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom futbol o'ynay oladi. / Ular suza oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'can' barcha shaxsda bir xil — -S yo'q, 'to' yo'q.
'He can plays' va 'He can to play' — ikkalasi ham XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can't hear a motorbike.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men mototsiklni eshitmayapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: To'liq shakli 'cannot' — BITTA so'z bo'lib yoziladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Can + EGA + FE'L? → Yes, EGA can. / No, EGA can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you cook? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqat pishira olasizmi? — Ha. / Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'do/does' ishlatilmaydi. Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: DARAJA: EGA + can + FE'L + very/quite + well/fast
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can cook quite well. / She can swim very fast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ancha yaxshi ovqat pishiraman. / U juda tez suzadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Daraja so'zi fe'ldan KEYIN keladi. 'well' sifat uchun, 'fast' tezlik uchun.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can hear a cat, but I can't hear a motorbike.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men mushukni eshityapman, lekin mototsiklni eshitmayapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' oldidan vergul qo'yiladi. Ikki qarama-qarshi gapni birlashtiradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you help me, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu yerda 'can' qobiliyat emas — muloyim ILTIMOS. 'please' oxirida, vergul bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you read this for me, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buni menga o'qib bera olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'please' oxirida, vergul bilan. Buyruq gapdan ('Read this') ancha muloyim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ann can use the computer very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ann kompyuterdan juda yaxshi foydalana oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roq emas, 'please' yo'q — demak bu qobiliyat, iltimos emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: IMLO: How do you spell it? → HARF - HARF - double HARF ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How do you spell it? — A - double N - A ... H - U - G - H - E - S.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buni qanday yozasiz? — A - ikkita N - A ...
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ism va familiya orasida qisqa pauza. Ikkilangan harf uchun 'double'.

sentencePatterns.formula: RO'YXAT: What's your name/address? · How old are you? · What's your phone number?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your home address? — 7, Green Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uy manzilingiz qanday? — Green ko'chasi, 7-uy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Manzil ingliz tilida TESKARI tartibda: uy raqami → ko'cha → shahar.
O'zbekchada 'Green ko'chasi, 7-uy', inglizchada '7, Green Street'.

sentencePatterns.formula: XIZMAT: Can I help you? → Yes please. I'd like to ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes please. I'd like to join the tennis club.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Tennis klubiga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Do'kon, klub, bankda eng ko'p eshitiladigan savol. Javobda 'I'd like to' — muloyim shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: SALOM: SALOMLASHISH + How are you? → JAVOB + And you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Good morning, Paul. How are you? — Very well, thanks. And you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xayrli tong, Paul. Qalaysiz? — Juda yaxshi, rahmat. Siz-chi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javob bergach savolni QAYTARISH shart — aks holda qo'pol eshitiladi.
Qaytarish uchun: 'And you?' yoki 'How are you?'

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Goodbye. Have a nice evening. — You too. Goodbye.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xayr. Kechangiz xayrli o'tsin. — Sizga ham. Xayr.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'You too' — tilakni qaytarish. Juda tez-tez ishlatiladi.
Uzun javob shart emas: 'You too' o'zi yetarli.

sentencePatterns.formula: E'LON: Hi! My name's X and I'm ... → ... → CHAQIRIQ
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hi! My name's Aziz and I'm fifteen years old. ... Please e-mail me today!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom! Mening ismim Aziz va men o'n besh yoshdaman. ... Bugunoq menga e-xat yozing!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
E'lon HAR DOIM chaqiriq bilan tugaydi — aks holda o'quvchi javob bermaydi.
Uchta tayyor variant bor (Please e-mail me / be my pen pal / Hope to hear).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The man with a beard is my teacher.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soqolli erkak — mening o'qituvchim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' — 'who has got' ning qisqa varianti. Gapni ixchamlashtiradi:
  'the man who has got a beard' → 'the man with a beard'
